input.summary: Tamarack State University RFP TSU-27-014 Custodial Services, Attachment C (Rev 1 per Addendum No. 1). Registered all 24 rows of C-1 Building Summary: 17 included buildings (372,074 gross SF; 267,430 cleanable SF, the pricing basis), Bldg 045 Environmental Field Station deleted by Addendum No. 1, and 6 Part B buildings (025 Hagen Hall vacant/scheduled for demolition; 027 STEM Innovation Annex Option 1; 060, 061, 062, 070 excluded). Addendum changes applied: 019 gross 15,269 (was 14,549), 012 frequency 7/wk (was 6/wk). Floor covering areas from C-3 and APPA levels recorded per building. C-2 room data used only for rest-room counts (breakdown of C-1 buildings, not a separate workload table). No grounds, dining or prior-award data in the package.
unresolved: Contract period (base + options) is not stated in Attachment C; only Option 1 (STEM Innovation Annex 027, est. completion 12/2027) is mentioned.
027 STEM Innovation Annex: cleanable area TBD (only 38,500 SF design gross); priced at the Cleanable Sq Ft unit price if Option 1 is exercised.
016 Bergstrom Hall: 2nd-floor rooms coded 060 (784 SF net) offline until 01/2027, to be added by contract modification; not in the 17,136 cleanable SF.
Floor finish groupings are mine: C-3 CPT+CPT-T=carpet, VCT+LVT+SV+RB=resilient, CT+TZ=hard tile, SC+EP=concrete, WD=wood.
RFP sections referenced (4.6 holidays, 4.8, 4.9, 5.3) and Attachment D price schedule are not in the package.
